caption: The drawing depicts a doll seated upright against a plain, light beige background. The doll has a round face with pale skin, black circular eyes, arched dark eyebrows, and a small red mouth. The hair is brown, parted in the center, and styled into two prominent curled sections that fall to either side of the head. The doll is dressed in a peach-colored, off-the-shoulder dress featuring pinkish hues and decorated with white lace patterns along the neckline, sleeves, and upper bodice. The skirt is wide and flowing, made up of soft folds in different shades of peach and pink. The visible arms are pale, with mitten-like hands emerging from the short sleeves. Beneath the dress, a cream or light tan petticoat or underskirt is visible, along with similarly colored cloth feet, one of which has a slightly rounded tip. The composition centers the doll and leaves ample blank space on all sides, with the artist's initials "RPB" visible toward the lower right corner.
title: Doll
